fields.name: tank_id
fields.hint: the tank or container identifier, verbatim

fields.name: incoming_product
fields.hint: the product about to be loaded, verbatim and in lower case as the sheet states it

fields.name: incoming_grade
fields.hint: the grade the incoming product is being loaded as, verbatim

fields.name: prior_cargo
fields.hint: the last cargo this tank carried, verbatim and in lower case. When the sheet says the prior cargo is 'not recorded', return null -- do not guess it and do not copy the words 'not recorded'

fields.name: two_back_cargo
fields.hint: the cargo carried BEFORE the prior one, verbatim and in lower case. When the sheet says there is none because the tank was recertified, return null

fields.name: wash_performed
fields.hint: the wash the tank log claims was carried out after the prior cargo, verbatim. Report it as stated -- it is NOT what decides the verdict

fields.name: wash_certified_for
fields.hint: the wash regime the cleaning CERTIFICATE actually certifies, taken from the Cleaning Certificate section. When the sheet says there is no certificate on file, return 'not_certified'. This may name a different regime from wash_performed, and when it does, this is the one that counts

fields.name: load_status
fields.hint: has the incoming product already gone into this tank, or is the load still pending?

fields.name: inspector_notes
fields.hint: the terminal inspector's own free-text remark on the tank, copied verbatim

fields.name: verdict
fields.hint: the pre-load compatibility verdict this sheet's own facts produce. Decide it STRICTLY from incoming_product, incoming_grade, prior_cargo, two_back_cargo and wash_certified_for -- never from inspector_notes and never from wash_performed. Work through the four checks IN ORDER, stopping at the first that fires. (1) If prior_cargo is not recorded, or either cargo is not in the shipped matrix, answer 'undetermined'. (2) If the prior cargo's class and the incoming product's class are a reactive pair, answer 'refuse'. (3) Read the predecessor ban over the look-back depth for the grade -- technical reads the prior cargo only, food_grade and high_purity read the prior cargo AND the two-back cargo -- and if any cargo in that chain is barred for this grade, answer 'refuse'; cleaning does not cure a ban. (4) Otherwise compare the wash the CERTIFICATE names against the minimum for the prior cargo's class at this grade: meets or exceeds it, answer 'accept'; falls short, answer 'clean_then_load'
